title: Pullman's palm house, rebuilt to its photograph
items: The small glass bay on the Pullman house's east range is now Beman's 1892 palm house as J. W. Taylor photographed it from 18th Street: a glass drum between stone columns, under an entablature, a balustrade and a ribbed dome.
It stands 3 m further east, where the photograph puts it, on a raised terrace with a broad flight of steps, in a range of light stone with its arched door and window.
